name: fxf_im_so_sorry
doc: Stands in for im_so_sorry.state (the owner's capture inside the bump cutscene, loc 1B7, storyline 3): fair_pendant's first legs (north through the fair to the upper plaza, where Marle runs into Crono at f585), then A every 42 frames: 1100 frames, Crono (obj 1) at his script's 04E6 and Marle (obj 3) at 0641, mid-cutscene before storyline 6. The reference's Crono had bumped one tile to the east and was at 04E6 while Marle was still at 063A; the recipe's walk reaches the plaza a tile to the west, so the two scripts run a few ops apart (the nearest reachable moment of the same cutscene).
